L84: # Release notes
L85: 
L86: This page documents updates to the Gemini API.
L87: ## September 15, 2026
L88: 
L89:   * Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking generally available (GA): Released two new audio-to-audio models for real-time voice applications using the Live API:
L90:     * Gemini 3.8 Live (cite7†`gemini-3.8-live` ): The default option for most low-latency voice agent experiences and real-time dialogue without reasoning delays. Features interleaved reasoning, default asynchronous function calling, and full session client content updates.
L91:     * Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (cite8†`gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking` ): High-reasoning audio-to-audio model supporting background reasoning during live audio interactions, recommended when higher background reasoning is required.
L92: To get started, see the cite9†Live API guide , the cite10†Capabilities guide , and the cite5†Thinking guide .
L93: ## September 3, 2026
L94: 
L95:   * Lyria 3.5 generally available (GA): Released the next generation of Google's music generation model:
L96: 
L97:     * cite11†`lyria-3.5` : Full-length song generation with improved musical coherence, natural vocals, and fine-grained duration and structural control.
L98: 
L99: The model supports text and image inputs and generates high-fidelity 44.1 kHz stereo audio. See the cite12†Music generation guide for details and code samples.
L100: ## September 2, 2026
L101: 
L102:   * Gemini 3.8 Flash generally available (GA): Released `gemini-3.8-flash`, our most intelligent Flash model, engineered for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows.
L103: 
L104: To get started, see the cite13†Gemini 3.8 Flash model page and the cite14†Latest model guide .
L105: ## September 1, 2026
L106: 
L107:   * Agentic video understanding: Released agentic video understanding for Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite across the Interactions and GenerateContent APIs. The model dynamically navigates video timelines, requesting transcripts, frames, or audio tracks on demand. This approach uses up to 88% fewer tokens for long-form content compared to static processing.
L108: 
L109: To get started, see the cite15†Agentic video understanding guide.
L110: ## August 27, 2026
L111: 
L112:   * Gemini Omni Flash generally available (GA): Released `gemini-omni-1.1-flash`, the GA version of our fast, conversational video generation and editing model. This release includes significant new capabilities:
L113:     * Video extension: Seamlessly extend existing videos by generating continuations at the end of a clip using the `extend` task or directly with a prompt.
L114:     * Interpolation (first + last frame): Generate a video transitioning between two images using the `image_to_video` task with up to 2 images.
L115:     * Resolution control: New `resolution` parameter in `video_config` supports `360p`, `720p` (default), `1080p`, and `4k` outputs. 1080p and 4K outputs are generated using upscaling.
L116: The existing `gemini-omni-flash-preview` endpoint will be deprecated on September 30, 2026.
L117: 
L118: To get started, see the cite16†Gemini Omni Flash model page and the cite17†omni guide .
L119: ## August 26, 2026
L120: 
L121:   * Gemini 3.5 Transcribe generally available (GA): Released two dedicated speech-to-text models based on Gemini's audio understanding:
L122:     * Gemini 3.5 Transcribe (`gemini-3.5-transcribe`): High-accuracy, low-latency non-streaming speech-to-text with utterance-based language detection across 85+ languages, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, and custom vocabulary biasing (up to 1,000 terms).
L123:     * Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live (`gemini-3.5-transcribe-live`): Low-latency, bidirectional streaming speech-to-text over WebSockets using the Live API, supporting interim and finalized transcription events, Smart transcription mode, and multiple Voice Activity Detection (VAD) strategies.
L124: To get started, see the cite18†Audio transcription guide , the cite19†Live transcription guide , and the cite20†Gemini 3.5 Transcribe model page .
L125: ## August 13, 2026
L126: 
L127:   * Gemini 3.7 Flash generally available (GA): Released our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents:
L128: 
L129:     * Gemini 3.7 Flash (`gemini-3.7-flash`): Substantial improvements across software engineering, web development, and agentic workflows, available at an introductory price through December 31, 2026.
L130: 
L131: To get started, see the cite21†Gemini 3.7 Flash model page and the cite14†Latest model guide .
L132: ## July 30, 2026
L133: 
L134:   * Gemini Robotics ER 2 in public preview: Released two new embodied reasoning model endpoints for robotics:
L135: 
L136:     * `gemini-robotics-er-2-preview`: Advanced spatial reasoning, agentic code execution, multi-step tool orchestration, video moment finding, progress classification, and multi-robot coordination.
L137:     * `gemini-robotics-er-2-streaming-preview`: Optimized for real-time text streaming using the Live API, enabling low-latency robot agents with bidirectional audio and video input.
L138: Both model endpoints accept text, image, video, and audio inputs and support function calling with blocking behavior for physical robot actions. To get started, see the cite22†Gemini Robotics ER overview . For real-time streaming use cases, see cite23†Robotics with streaming .
L139: 
L140:   * Deprecation announcement: The `gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview` model will be cite24†shut down on August 31, 2026.
L141: ## July 21, 2026
L142: 
L143:   * Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite generally available (GA): Released stable, production-ready versions of our latest 3.x Flash models:
L144:     * Gemini 3.6 Flash (`gemini-3.6-flash`): Features improved token efficiency and code/agentic planning capabilities at a lower price point than 3.5 Flash, resolving developer feedback around output verbosity.
L145:     * Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`): Offers a low-latency, highly cost-effective subagent option designed for high-volume automation.
L146: 
L147: To learn more, see the cite14†Latest Gemini model guide.
L148:   * Deprecated parameters: The sampling parameters `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` are now deprecated. See the cite25†Latest Gemini Model for details.
L149: ## July 6, 2026
L150: 
L151:   * cite26†Developer logs support for the Interactions API: logs for supported Interactions API calls are now viewable in the cite27†AI Studio dashboard†aistudio.google.com .
L152: ## June 30, 2026
L153: 
L154:   * Gemini Omni Flash in public preview: Released `gemini-omni-flash-preview`, a high-performance multimodal model designed for high-speed video generation and conversational video editing. Using the cite28†Interactions API , you can generate 3–10 second videos at 720p from text descriptions or animate still images, and then conversationally edit and refine the outputs. To get started, see the cite17†Gemini Omni Flash guide and the cite16†Gemini Omni Flash model card.
L155:   * Released `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image` (Nano Banana 2 Lite) to general availability (GA), our built-in multimodal model optimized for ultra-low latency and cost-effective image generation and editing. See the cite29†Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image model card and the cite30†Image generation guide.
L156: ## June 24, 2026
L157: 
L158:   * Computer Use: Launched public preview support for the cite31†Computer Use tool in Gemini 3.5 Flash. This release includes simplified actions with intents, built-in support for browser, mobile, and desktop environments, configurable safety policies, and advanced prompt injection detection.
L159: ## June 17, 2026
L160: 
L161:   * Streaming support for speech generation: Streaming via `streamGenerateContent` (and `stream: true` in the Interactions API) is now supported for the `gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview` model. To learn more, see the cite32†Text-to-Speech guide.
L162: ## June 15, 2026
L163: 
L164:   * Deprecation announcement: The following image generation models are being deprecated and will be cite24†shut down on August 17, 2026:
L165: 
L166:     * Imagen 4 and Gemini 3 Image models:
L167:       * `imagen-4.0-generate-001`
L168:       * `imagen-4.0-ultra-generate-001`
L169:       * `imagen-4.0-fast-generate-001`
L170: 
L171: To migrate your code to newer stable or preview endpoints, refer to the cite33†Gemini deprecations page.
L172:   * Deprecation announcement: The following video generation models are being deprecated and will be cite24†shut down on June 30, 2026:
L173: 
L174:     * Veo models:
L175:       * `veo-2.0-generate-001`
L176:       * `veo-3.0-generate-001`
L177:       * `veo-3.0-fast-generate-001`
L178: Update your integration to either use the Veo 3.1 preview model IDs (`veo-3.1-generate-preview`, `veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview`) or the 3.1 GA models available through the cite34†Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform†docs.cloud.google.com to avoid service interruptions.
L179: 
L180:   * Deprecation announcement: The experimental GMP Contextual View tool (a fixed interface for Grounding with Google Maps outputs) will cite24†shut down on June 15, 2026:
L181: ## June 1, 2026
L182: 
L183:   * The following Gemini 2.0 models are now cite24†shut down :
L184: 
L185:     * `gemini-2.0-flash`
L186:     * `gemini-2.0-flash-001`
L187:     * `gemini-2.0-flash-lite`
L188:     * `gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001`
L189: 
L190: Use cite35†`gemini-3.5-flash` or cite36†`gemini-3.1-flash-lite` instead.
L191: ## May 28, 2026
L192: 
L193:   * Released `gemini-3.1-flash-image` (Nano Banana 2) and `gemini-3-pro-image` (Nano Banana Pro), the generally available (GA) versions of our native visual models, cite37†Gemini 3.1 Flash Image and cite38†Gemini 3 Pro Image .
L194:   * Video-to-image generation support: You can now pass a video file (via direct upload or as a public YouTube URL) as multimodal context alongside a text prompt to generate high-quality thumbnails, cinematic movie posters, or summary infographics. This feature is supported exclusively on the `gemini-3.1-flash-image` model. To learn more, see the cite39†Video-to-image generation guide.
L195:   * Deprecation announcement: The `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview` and `gemini-3-pro-image-preview` models are deprecated and will be cite24†shut down on June 25, 2026.
L196: ## May 25, 2026
L197: 
L198:   * The `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` model has been cite24†shut down . Use cite36†`gemini-3.1-flash-lite` instead.
